Creating an 8-Second Tarot Video
For an 8-second video about the love spread, speed and visual clarity are essential. Here are two approaches you can combine or choose from, depending on your desired outcome.

Option 1: Fast Narration and Dynamic Transitions
This approach focuses on showing the cards appearing rapidly in their position while a voice-over or on-screen text names them.

Script/On-screen Text (with Spanish card meanings):

Second 0-1: Title: "Love Spread" (image of a tarot card with a heart or love symbol)
Second 1-2: Card 1 appears in the center. Text: "Hoy en tu corazón"
Second 2-3: Card 2 appears crossing the first. Text: "Lo que te bloquea"
Second 3-4: Cards 3 (left) and 5 (right) appear. Text: "Pasado y futuro"
Second 4-5: Cards 4 (top) and 6 (bottom) appear. Text: "Logros y cimientos"
Second 5-7: Cards 7, 8, 9, 10 appear in a side column. Text: "Emociones, influencias y resultado"
Second 7-8: Final text: "¿Quieres tu lectura? ¡Pregunta!" or "Discover your love" (with a subtle call to action).
Practical Tips:

Use inspiring but non-intrusive background music.
Transitions between card appearances should be very fast.
Ensure text is large and easy to read. Consider using different colors to highlight each card position.
If using a voice-over, ensure it's concise and clearly articulated.
